_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for business details. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/build.py

business.name: Pellikal Window Enhancements
business.serviceArea: Long Island · Nassau · Suffolk · Queens · Brooklyn · Manhattan · NYC

_analyticsComment: PRODUCTION Google IDs. The GTM container snippet is stamped into every public page by tools/build.py. GA4 is configured INSIDE GTM - do not add a gtag.js snippet to the pages or page views will be counted twice.

analytics._idNote: GTM is the ONLY tag installed on the pages. GA4 and Google Ads are configured INSIDE the GTM container - never add gtag.js to a page or measurement double-counts. The GA4 and Ads IDs are recorded here purely as the authoritative reference for the marketing specialist.
analytics._retiredGa4: G-TPD5SKWWVC - WRONG/OLD property. Must not be used anywhere.
analytics._consentComment: Google Consent Mode v2. build.py stamps these values into the consent block at the top of every tracked page's <head>, ABOVE the GTM snippet, and publishes them to js/consent.js as window.PELLIKAL_CONSENT_SETTINGS. All four optional categories always default to denied - that is not configurable here, by design. See docs/CONSENT-MODE.md.

consent._versionNote: v2 = granular Analytics/Advertising categories (14 Sep 2026); every v1 all/necessary choice was invalidated and visitors re-asked. Bump again only if what you measure materially changes. Stored format: VERSION:a0|a1:d0|d1:DATE.
consent._redactionNote: true = while ad_storage is denied, Google Ads redacts ad-click identifiers in its cookieless pings. Turned off automatically once a visitor accepts.
consent._nameNote: Letters, digits, _ and - only. The build fails on anything else.

_navComment: Order here = order in the menu. 'slug' is the folder name; home is "".
_footerComment: Links shown in the footer columns.
_formsComment: THE quote form, defined once. build.py renders partials/quote-form.html into every <!-- @partial:quote-form:VARIANT --> region, so /contact/, /residential/ and /window-inserts/ share one piece of markup and one submission path. The Formspree endpoint is NOT duplicated here - build.py reads it out of js/config.js, which stays the single place it lives.

forms._successNote: Where a CONFIRMED successful Formspree response sends the visitor. build.py turns this into the correct relative link for each page's depth. Google Ads counts the lead on that page load.
forms._serviceNote: 'Residential Window Film' is NEW - the dropdown had no residential option to preselect. See docs/LEAD-FLOW.md. Order is for readability only; the code matches on slug, not position.
forms._variantNote: leadSource stays contact_form on all three, so the existing contact_form_submit trigger keeps firing exactly as before. formLocation is the NEW non-PII parameter that tells the three apart in GA4.

_syncOnlyComment: Files with no header/footer, but which still contain the phone/email and must stay in sync.
_pagesComment: Every page on the site. 'redirect: true' also creates the old .html forwarder at the root.

pages._note: Lead-confirmation page. Damian's Google Ads conversion fires on this page load, so it MUST keep the GTM container. Kept out of the sitemap and marked noindex because it is a confirmation screen, not SEO content. Deliberately NOT disallowed in robots.txt - blocking the crawl would stop Google ever seeing the noindex. redirect:false because the exact address is /thankyou/ with no .html forwarder.
